description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%9E%AC%EC%9B%8C%EC%A3%BC%EB%8A%94-%EC%82%AC%EC%9D%B4/2986), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60609584)  
Tae-eun', who came from the provinces and lived in a shabby old house, gave up on a pretty house in the evening. I live to save even a little bit, but the desire to live in a nice house is growing day by day.

I live alone in a nice house

With the scars of letting go of the cat I had been raising due to the stress of serialization

'Jungmoon', a webtoon writer who can't sleep well

First, he meets Tae-eun, who resembles the cat in appearance and even the feel of his fur, and falls into a sound sleep.

Sleep is essential to life.

Because he desperately needed that sleep, Jeong-moon made Tae-eun an offer that was difficult to refuse despite the embarrassment...
